The existing structural walker now validates every numeric token with the unchanged grammar helper; exact conversion remains restricted to the four genuine gate coordinates. Arithmetic, codec and document bytes retain their reviewed pins.

Independent Python confirms all 2,100 decisions and 1,116 exact legal roundtrips. Original four failing/control fixtures are reused byte-for-byte. Corrected baseline RED has 48 failures; all failures, fixture correction, runner startup error and exponent warnings are retained.

Evidence: .planning/deepeye-resume-20261018/g02-json-number-grammar-repair-20261020/{findings.md,manifest.json,receipt.json,source-before.json,source-after.json,execution-ledger.json,candidate-additive.patch}. Native terminal and exact persisted result are recorded separately in native-complete-response.json and receipt.json.

Main review/adoption, combined integration and visual checks remain pending. This establishes bounded tested NUMBER grammar behavior, not full JSON conformance or product acceptance.
